warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Door heights 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง; window heights read from the sill + window chains (น1/น2 0.95 + 1.10 = 2.05; น3 1.65 + 0.50 = 2.15).
The frame/sash colour is printed 'อลูมิเนียมอบขาว' (baked-white aluminium) on every aluminium type.
